scope: Prospective post-training evaluation, frozen before any candidate optimizer step; no admission waiver.

training.initialization: Original configured sp_unet_backbone.pth; frozen M95 diagnostic weights are not candidate training initialization.
training.schedule_and_early_stop: Existing project and queue policy unchanged; no seed, schedule or hyperparameter search.

primary.split: Existing fixed native validation split; no test-set mechanism selection.
primary.metric: Native mIoU, same evaluator and checkpoint rule as project baseline/champion.
primary.comparability: Historical scalar results alone do not produce paired uncertainty. Re-evaluate matched reference predictions when available; otherwise mark pairwise uncertainty unknown.

uncertainty.interval: Scene-clustered paired interval on full validation predictions, with actual expression and independent-scene denominators; insufficient or degenerate support remains inconclusive.
uncertainty.noise_floor: UNKNOWN until independent repeats or an appropriate paired reference are available; do not invent a fixed numerical noise threshold.

subgroups: Native official unique/multiple labels only where evaluator metadata is available; otherwise unknown.
Target has versus lacks a cross-fine-leaf physical contact, defined from fixed geometry and evaluation GT only; never used for inference routing or candidate selection.
material_harm_rule: For a supported subgroup, investigate paired mIoU degradation of at least 0.002 with scene-clustered interval wholly below zero and larger than an independently estimated noise floor. If the floor, paired reference or adequate scenes are unavailable, harm is inconclusive, not PASS. A single adverse scene triggers diagnosis, not automatic rejection.
resources: Original uniform counted FLOPs<=10G; report matched latency median/P90 and allocated/reserved peaks. Peak memory +15% requires at least +0.003 trained mIoU under the existing rule. Full optimizer peak is unknown until measured.
claims: Pre-training controls establish implementation and causal path, not trained efficacy, publication novelty or generalization.
forbidden_changes: No gate, precision, tolerance, operator, data, seed, schedule, scheduler, historical evidence or permission waiver.
